2/22/2023 - Final Order PSC-2023-0097-FOF-WS approves name changes for Duval Waterworks, Inc. (WS982), Cert Nos. 551-S and 641-W; Gator Waterworks, Inc. (WU984), Cert No. 555-W; Lake Talquin Waterworks, Inc. (WU989), Cert No. 678-W; Seminole Waterworks, Inc. (WU981), Cert No. 672-W; Okaloosa Waterworks, Inc. (WU988), Cert No. 676-W; and Sunny Hills Utility Company (WS966), Cert Nos. 435-S and 501-W, to North Florida Community Water Systems, Inc., effective on date of order. (DN 01227-2023) -dm
